Name: Iron Stone Cemetery Fence - OUTDATED
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A mod replacement for your stone fence, art by eemiestardew
Description:
Hi all, Minerva here!  This mod will hopefully be updated sometime soon so you can continue to enjoy it <3  It will be moving to Moddrop as well, for better moderation of asset use.

WARNING: DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD ANY OTHER PLACE THAN NEXUSMODS OR MODDROP. WWW.STARDEWVALLEYMODS.NET STEALS MY AND OTHER PEOPLE'S MODS AND UPLOADS THEM ON THEIR WEBSITE WITHOUT PERMISSION. DON'T DOWNLOAD OUR MODS THERE.
_____

Hollo, this mod replaces Fence2 in the game, which is the stone fence. I know it doesn't look or work perfectly, but I wanted to release it anyway lol.
Place in the LooseSprites folder under Content.
If you want it to replace a different fence, you can rename the xnb.
Fence1 for the wood fence, Fence3 for the iron fence, Fence5 for the hardwood fence.

I chose to make three variations for matching purposes. 

I recommend[this mod](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/rues-creepy-curios-and-spooky-aesthetics-updated-11-7.126419/) (which I was clearly inspired by) if you want an iron fence mod that looks like this, but without the stone. Search for the 'dark gothic iron fence' one. Made by Ruevian.
[This](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/stone-floor-retexture.114383/#post-2889520) is the stone floor mod that you can see in one of the preview images. the image in this thread is broken but I can assure you it's the right mod. Made by jenwe.
The black stone floor is a recolour that came from [here](http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/a-whole-bunch-of-things-pets-paths-stable-etc.111044/) originally (click on 'Flooring collection')! Made by Maleha.

Don't reupload or redistribute please.
